title: ChArUcoBoard
description: Physical geometry of a ChArUco calibration board: a chessboard pattern with embedded ArUco markers used for camera calibration and pose estimation. Deliberately excludes rendering concerns so the same board can be reused across render targets.

squares_x.description: Number of chessboard squares across the board.

squares_y.description: Number of chessboard squares down the board.

square_length.description: Physical side length of each chessboard square. All dimensions must use the same unit.

marker_length.description: Physical side length of each ArUco marker. Must be smaller than square_length; not enforced by this schema, validate at the application layer.

ArucoDictionary.title: ArucoDictionary
ArucoDictionary.description: Predefined OpenCV marker dictionary used to generate and detect the board.
